mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes nicotine, potentially increasing nicotine levels and cardiovascular effects; nicotine also induces CYP3A4, which may reduce clarithromycin efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased nicotine-related cardiovascular symptoms (tachycardia, hypertension, palpitations) and consider alternative antibiotics if possible or dose adjustment of nicotine replacement products.
